title: My Wife, a Body to Love
writer: Franco Daniele, Mario Imperoli, Silvia Silvani
actors: Silvano Tranquilli, Antonella Murgia, Peter Lee Lawrence
plot: The story of a nymphomaniac model with a somewhat older businessman husband. Although he is aware of his wife's many, many infidelities, it is unclear for a LONG time whether he is actually jealous of them or turned on
